answer: Because the grove solution is checked at the marble gate and logged, the jetty audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 15 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 85 pays that 136 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
